result.coordinates: bbox/feet in image pixels of the clip frame; pitch_xy and positions in metres, x from the left goal line, y from the NEAR touchline; names and shirts only within track B's names_live windows

how.detector: RF-DETR Medium 1.11.2 (COCO-pretrained, Apache-2.0; not trained by us), threshold 0.3 people; the ball on 640 px tiles of the full 1920x1080 frame, threshold 0.2
how.pitch: our camera calibration: a pan-tilt-zoom camera fitted to the pitch lines each frame, feet (bottom centre of the box) projected to metres
how.teams: kit colour of each box's torso, clustered into two teams (k-means), keepers by position
